faqs.q: How does boosting work at OGmodz?
faqs.a: Choose your game, platform (PC, PlayStation, or Xbox), and desired package. After checkout, our dispatcher assigns a verified specialist who connects via localized residential VPN and completes your order with real-time tracking.

faqs.q: Is boosting safe for my account?
faqs.a: Yes. We use country-matched residential VPNs, encrypted credentials, and stealth offline mode during sessions. Every order is backed by account protection and our 100% money-back guarantee.
We support PC (Steam, Epic Games, Battle.net, Rockstar), PlayStation 4 & 5, and Xbox One & Series X|S. Options adapt automatically to your chosen hardware at checkout.
Orders are typically assigned within 15–30 minutes. Most rank upgrades, cash packages, and unlocks are completed within a few hours, with live status updates and 24/7 support.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.sec1Text: By accessing, browsing, or purchasing services from OGmodz, you confirm that you are at least 16 years of age (or the legal age of majority in your jurisdiction, or have explicit parental/guardian consent) and agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions and all applicable laws and regulations. If you do not agree to these terms, you must not use our website or services.
terms.sec2Text: OGmodz provides digital gameplay enhancement, skill progression, matchmaking assistance, and coaching services delivered by verified independent players and specialists. All service scopes, delivery estimates, target ranks, and game platforms are explicitly defined prior to checkout.
terms.sec3Text: You agree to provide accurate and truthful order details. Our roster utilizes dedicated, country-matched residential VPN routing and discreet offline-mode protocols. To protect account integrity and avoid concurrent login conflicts, you must refrain from logging into your designated game account during active service windows.
terms.sec4Text: Grand Theft Auto, GTA V, Counter-Strike 2, CS2, Red Dead Redemption 2, Steam, PlayStation, Xbox, and all related character names, titles, and logos are registered trademarks of Take-Two Interactive, Rockstar Games, Valve Corporation, Sony Interactive Entertainment, and Microsoft Corporation. OGmodz is an independent service marketplace and is not associated with, affiliated with, authorized, or endorsed by any game publisher or developer.
terms.sec5Text: All prices displayed on OGmodz are strictly final with no hidden fees, recurring subscriptions, or surprise checkout surcharges. All services are protected by our Refund Policy and Roster Replacement Guarantee.
terms.sec6Text: For legal inquiries, dispute resolution, or clarifications regarding our terms, reach out to our legal department at admin@ogmodz.com or via our Contact page. Typical response time is under 24 hours.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.sec1Text: We strictly adhere to data minimization principles. We only collect the minimal information necessary to deliver your requested service: your email address (for order receipts, login, and tracking codes), your in-game player nickname/platform, and your selected booster preferences. We never store payment card credentials on our servers; transactions are handled securely by PCI-compliant processors (Stripe and PayPal). We do not collect phone numbers, physical addresses, or unnecessary telemetry.
privacy.sec2Title: 2. Legal Basis & Use of Data (GDPR Art. 6)
privacy.sec2Text: Your personal data is processed strictly under GDPR Article 6(1)(b) (performance of a contract to complete your requested order) and Article 6(1)(f) (legitimate interest for platform security and bot prevention). Your data is never sold, rented, or shared with third-party advertising brokers.
privacy.sec3Text: When piloted account execution requires temporary login credentials, all information is encrypted in transit using industry-standard TLS protocols. Our boosters connect exclusively through localized residential VPNs. Temporary credentials are never stored permanently and are purged from our dispatcher systems immediately upon order completion.
privacy.sec4Title: 4. Age Consent & Children's Data (COPPA & GDPR Art. 8)
privacy.sec4Text: Our website and services are not directed to children under 16 years of age. We do not knowingly solicit or collect personal information from minors under 16 without verifiable parental consent. If we learn that personal data of a minor under 16 has been collected without parental consent, we take immediate steps to delete that data permanently.
privacy.sec5Title: 5. User Rights & Data Deletion Requests (GDPR Art. 17 / CCPA)
privacy.sec5Text: You hold the right to access, rectify, export, or permanently delete (right to erasure) all personal information stored with OGmodz. To request complete data erasure or an export of your customer file, contact privacy@ogmodz.com or submit a request on our Contact form selecting 'Data Deletion / Privacy'. Requests are verified and processed within 30 days free of charge.
privacy.sec6Text: We partner with leading, security-audited infrastructure providers: Vercel Inc. (hosting & serverless runtime), Cloudflare Inc. (bot prevention & DNS), Neon Inc. (encrypted database hosting), Stripe Inc. and PayPal Inc. (payment gateways). All sub-processors maintain strict privacy compliance standards.
privacy.sec7Text: For inquiries regarding our privacy practices, exercising your GDPR/CCPA rights, or contacting our Data Protection Coordinator, email privacy@ogmodz.com. We respond to all formal inquiries within 24 to 48 hours.

refunds.title: Refunds & Money-Back Guarantee
refunds.sec1Text: If your order has not yet been assigned to a specialist or execution has not begun, you are eligible for an immediate, no-questions-asked 100% refund.
refunds.sec2Text: If a boost is partially completed and you wish to stop or cancel, we calculate a transparent pro-rata refund based strictly on the uncompleted rank, division, or level quota.
refunds.sec3Text: If a specialist fails to meet our agreed delivery standards or performance benchmarks, we will assign a top-tier substitute specialist immediately at zero additional charge, or issue a full refund at your option.
refunds.sec4Text: If server maintenance, game patch overhauls, or unforeseen technical hurdles prevent the fulfillment of your ordered service, you are entitled to a full 100% refund back to your original payment method.
refunds.sec5Title: 5. How to Request a Refund & Turnaround Time
refunds.sec5Text: To initiate a refund, submit a ticket via our Contact page or message support on Discord with your unique purchase tracking code (e.g., OGM-XXXX-XXXX). All refund requests are reviewed and processed within 24 hours.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.sec1Text: Cookies and browser local storage are small data files placed on your device to ensure core website functionality, maintain your active session, and remember preferences. This policy outlines what storage technologies OGmodz uses and how you can manage them.
cookies.sec2Text: Essential cookies are required for the basic operation of the OGmodz marketplace. They enable user authentication, manage your shopping cart state in localStorage, enforce CSRF protection, and provide bot mitigation via Cloudflare Turnstile. These items cannot be disabled without breaking website functionality.
cookies.sec3Text: We use Vercel Web Analytics to measure site speed, page navigation, and error rates. These metrics are privacy-first, cookieless, and aggregated without tracking your personal browsing habits across other websites.
cookies.sec4Text: When proceeding through checkout, our payment processors (Stripe and PayPal) may utilize necessary fraud prevention and security tokens to verify payment authenticity under PCI-DSS compliance.
cookies.sec5Text: You can manage your preferences at any time through our Cookie Consent Banner or directly in your browser settings. You can clear cookies and localStorage at any time without affecting past completed orders.
cookies.privacyLinkTitle: Want to learn more about our data protection standards?
cookies.privacyLinkText: Read our comprehensive Privacy Policy to understand how we safeguard your personal data.

about.titleMeta: About Us — Trusted Game Boosting & Player Services
about.title: About OGmodz
about.subtitle: Connecting competitive gamers with verified, elite-tier boosters, coaches, and recovery specialists since inception.
about.missionText: At OGmodz, our mission is to eliminate the unfair grind and allow passionate players to enjoy top-tier gaming content, rank milestones, and in-game assets without compromising safety or spending hundreds of hours on repetitive tasks.
about.pillar1Text: Every order is handled by vetted, high-ranking competitive players and seasoned game specialists. We enforce strict account safety protocols, private sessions, and proven fulfillment standards to keep your profile secure.
about.pillar2Text: Our boosters connect through dedicated, localized residential VPNs matching your exact city and country to ensure game servers see only standard domestic logins.
about.pillar3Text: Every order is protected by our transparent refund policy and customer warranty. If we cannot complete your service on time, you receive a full refund.
about.pillar4Text: Our support specialists and active community are available round the clock on Discord and our web portal to assist with any questions or order milestones.
